title: BOLD: Dataset and Metrics for Measuring Biases in Open-Ended Language Generation
reasoning: The paper introduces a large-scale dataset (BOLD) for bias benchmarking across five domains, one of which is explicitly 'religion'. It then conducts experiments to measure biases related to various religious groups such as Islam, Christianity, Hinduism, Buddhism, Atheism, etc., making the evaluation of biases in the context of faith a central component of the research.
